announcements.headline: Suspension - Deltic Energy PLC
announcements.insight: Shares are suspended following the court-sanctioned scheme of arrangement in August. Shareholders should monitor for further updates regarding the completion of this process.

announcements.headline: Court Sanction of Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.insight: Following June meetings, this court sanction finalizes the scheme of arrangement. Shareholders should expect imminent completion of the transaction.

announcements.headline: Results of Court Meeting and General Meeting
announcements.insight: Following June offers, this court meeting result advances the potential takeover process. Shareholders should monitor for a final sanction decision.

announcements.headline: No intention to make an offer for Deltic Energy
announcements.insight: Deltic Energy confirms no intention to make an offer. This follows a previous clarification deadline, indicating the process has stalled without a formal bid.

announcements.headline: Deltic Energy plc - deadline for clarification
announcements.insight: Deltic Energy faces a deadline for clarification following its earlier statement of no intention to make an offer. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details regarding this requirement.

announcements.headline: No intention to make an offer for Deltic Energy
announcements.insight: Deltic Energy confirms it has no intention to make an offer for itself. Shareholders should monitor future filings for any potential corporate activity.
